name: The Salt Row
description: The bottom stick off Bram Kettle's tally board, burned SALT on the plank above where it hung: a notch for every crock the charcoal folk took home from the jetty, years of them, and Hob's fourth, still pale. Bram held it into the fog in the pines west of the camp until it went grey: now it holds the camp's memory of the colliers and the trade. A Remnant, made on purpose.
